Payload.Name: General
Payload.Description: Storage for general cargo: ore, refined materials, machinery, parts, anything that does not care where it is. Cheapest capacity per cubic metre and needs no power — the baseline every other hold is measured against.

Payload.Name: Fuel
Payload.Description: A sealed pressure vessel for things with no shape of their own: fuels, reaction mass, water, atmospheric gases. The only hold rated to carry a liquid or a gas.

Payload.Name: Battery
Payload.Description: Stored charge rather than stored mass — measured in kilojoules, not cubic metres. NOTE: energy is currently held by EnergyStoreAtb, a separate system, so nothing provides this cargo type.

Payload.Name: Cryogenic Storage
Payload.Description: Frozen people and frozen biology, held at temperature. The cheapest way to move a population, because a pod needs no air, no food and almost no crew — paid for in the two things a cabin gives you: the occupants cannot act, and they die if the plant stops.

Payload.Name: Passengers
Payload.Description: Living people, breathing: passengers, colonists, a drafted workforce, a research team, prisoners, refugees. The only hold whose contents can walk out and go to work, which is why it carries a pressure hull, air, water and stewards.

Payload.Name: Ordnance Storage
Payload.Description: Munitions, behind blast isolation and handling gear: missiles, shells, ground ammunition. The only hold rated for cargo that can detonate.

Payload.Name: Refrigerated
Payload.Description: Cooled and controlled: food, biomass, medical stock, anything alive. The only hold whose contents are still worth having when they arrive — everywhere else they spoil. Its cost is TIME: it must keep working for the whole voyage.

Payload.Name: Containment
Payload.Description: Shielded and isolated, for cargo that is dangerous to the ship carrying it: volatiles, radioactives, antimatter, biohazard, a live specimen. The only hold rated for cargo whose escape damages the carrier, and the heaviest capacity in the game because the shielding IS the capability.
